If you go this route, make sure you have a few loyal & very wealthy residential clients and then some rentals. If economy goes to shit, the wealthy clients will still keep you around, and rentals always need to be cleaned.

Cleaning doesn't seem like a skilled trade, but if you know how to care for marble, travertine, antique furniture and other less common materials, you'll come off as more professional and can get better pay and more jobs.
